266:t_005:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Oh... I'm sorry... One moment we were fighting $$サイデリアル$$, and suddenly another enemy was in front of us...」

266:t_005:6.en:
$$柿小路$$
「W-we've been thrown into this hell all of a sudden!」

266:t_005:7.en:
$$ボス$$
「Give me a break already! It's been nothing but this lately!」

266:t_006:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「A big gathering of $$バアル$$ suits us just fine! It'll be a rehearsal for dealing with this universe collapse!」

266:t_006:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「My world overcame the universe's collapse that comes every 12,000 years by completely destroying the $$宇宙怪獣$$ nest at the galactic center...」

266:t_006:4.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Everyone! Let's fight to protect this world!」

266:t_006:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「So if we crush $$バアル$$, we'll protect the universe!」

266:t_006:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「If we can't get through this, we can hardly protect the universe...!」

266:t_006:7.en:
$$葵$$
「Then let's do it... with everything we've got!」

266:t_006:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'm in! I'll show them humanity's stubbornness and hidden strength!」

266:t_006:9.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We've eaten our fill, and we're brimming with fighting spirit!」

266:t_006:10.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's fight, no matter what we're up against!」

266:t_007:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「But be careful. It looks like this is one hell of a dangerous place.」

266:t_007:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I-I'm detecting tremendous energy from over there!」

266:t_008:0.en:
$$メール$$
「What's that!? Is space tearing open!?」

266:t_008:1.en:
$n
「It's a dimensional rift, rather than a tear in space!」

266:t_008:2.en:
$$弁慶$$
「That energy is coming from there...」

266:t_008:3.en:
$$隼人$$
「The $$宇宙怪獣$$ and $$インベーダー#robot$$s may be fighting to obtain it.」

266:t_008:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「They're like those guys who come to Earth for $$次元力|lc$$!」

266:t_008:5.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$號$$... How much longer until you've stored enough energy to open a wormhole?」

266:t_008:7.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「You heard him, everyone! We fight with all our strength for four minutes, then escape with a hyperspace jump!」

266:t_008:8.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I understand! Let's really cut loose for those four minutes!」

266:t_008:9.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We will...! I have no intention of ending here!」

266:t_008:10.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Our targets are the $$宇宙怪獣$$ and $$インベーダー#robot$$s!」

266:t_008:11.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We'll teach them! Humanity will be the last one standing!!」

266:t_009:1.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, shake off the enemy and gather at the designated point!」

266:t_010:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You got lucky, $$バアル$$! Next time we meet, we'll fight it out to the end!」

266:t_010:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「And of course, we'll be the ones who win then, too!」

266:t_010:3.en:
$$柿小路$$
「That's just how young people should be.」

266:t_010:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「You're both still young, Executive Director and Managing Director!」

266:t_010:5.en:
$$赤木$$
「Exactly! You don't back down an inch, even facing hordes of $$バアル$$!」

266:t_010:8.en:
$$隼人$$
「Perhaps all of Earth's humanity is young...」

266:t_010:9.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Now that we've seen Dr. $$早乙女$$ and $$武蔵$$, I think I get what you mean.」

266:t_012:0.en:
$$渓$$
「$$號$$! Did you open the wormhole!?」

266:t_012:3.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「I've confirmed a distortion of the dimensional boundary. Its pattern is completely different from every transfer observed so far.」

266:t_012:4.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, return! A $$時空震動$$ is coming!!」

266:t_012:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
(It's beginning... No, is this the end...?)

266:t_014:1.en:
$$渓$$
「Fine by me! Since we've got the chance, I'll fight like we're wiping out every $$インベーダー#robot$$ here!」

266:t_015:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「The $$宇宙怪獣$$ seem to be prioritizing the $$インベーダー#robot$$s over us.」

266:t_015:2.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Urgh...! Being ignored is kind of frustrating!」

266:t_015:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Then we'll beat them down so they can't ignore us!」

266:t_100:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
($$ゲッター線$$, my ass...! And to hell with $$シンカ$$!)

266:t_100:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
(I'll live as my heart tells me! I'll be damned if I let $$ゲッター線$$ order me around!)

266:t_101:0.en:
$$渓$$
「What did you and Dad talk about, $$號$$?」

266:t_101:1.en:
$$號$$
「We discussed my mission, and $$ゲッターロボ$$'s.」

266:t_101:3.en:
$$號$$
「It's the duty closest to me, and the most important.」

266:t_101:4.en:
$$渓$$
「I don't really get it, but let's do our best together!」

266:t_101:5.en:
$$凱$$
(Urgh... It looks like I'm the only one being left out again...)

266:t_102:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(Big Sis... Now, for the first time, I understand why I came to this world.)

266:t_102:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(There are $$宇宙怪獣$$ in this world, too... $$ガンバスター$$ and I came here to fight them.)

266:t_102:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(I'll do my best, Big Sis...! With the flames of our two hearts, I'll protect humanity no matter what!)

266:t_103:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「It seems the $$宇宙怪獣$$ we fought were limited to the solar system...!」

266:t_103:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
「It does seem that way, Big Sis.」

266:t_103:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「But they're still $$宇宙怪獣$$! $$ディスヌフ$$ will take on these and the ones from our world alike!」

266:t_103:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm fired up! Right now, Big Sis... you're just like $$ノノリリ$$!」

266:t_104:0.en:
$n
(The true end comes once every 120 million years... But something else makes me uneasy...)

266:t_104:1.en:
$n
(What could it be...? Does Miss $$スズネ$$ feel it, too...?)
